title: Completed proper exchange with independent finite origins and ambient naturality
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be an adic datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with $P_n=A/I^n$ and $A_T=\lim_n(P_n)_T$. Let $p:V\to Y$ be proper and $g:Y'\to Y$ arbitrary, and form $V'=V\times_Y Y'$ with maps $p',\bar g$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Work in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ and its strict quotient towers. Write $\mathcal R_T$ for strict reduction, $\mathscr L_u,\mathscr P_u$ for derived tower pullback and direct image, and $L_T=R\lim$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback, prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits, prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality]. On the whole ambient derived category, put $P_u=L_{\mathrm{source}(u)}\mathscr L_u\mathcal R_{\mathrm{target}(u)}$; on complete objects this is completed pullback. Use the canonical diagram-site projection $\Pi_p:\mathcal R_YRp_*\to\mathscr P_p\mathcal R_V$ and strict exchange $v_\square$ fixed by the counit-tensor projection maps and ambient mate in [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map], and the direct-image/limit comparison $c_{p'}:Rp'_*L_{V'}\cong L_{Y'}\mathscr P_{p'}$.
The specified three-factor expression
$$\gamma_H=c_{p'}^{-1}\circ L_{Y'}(v_{\square,H})\circ L_{Y'}(\mathscr L_g\Pi_{p,H}):P_gRp_*H\longrightarrow Rp'_*P_{\bar g}H$$
is a natural transformation on every $H\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_V))$, with all endpoint identifications the indicated canonical ones. Thus for every $a:H\to H'$,
$$Rp'_*P_{\bar g}(a)\,\gamma_H=\gamma_{H'}\,P_gRp_*(a).$$
If $H$ is intrinsically derived $I$-complete [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] and each $H_n$ has an independently specified witness $\nu_V^*L_n\simeq H_n$, $L_n\in D^+(V_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], then this same $\gamma_H$ is an isomorphism and equals the specified completed proper exchange [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map]. Neither compatibility between the witnesses nor a common lower bound is required. Naturality of $\gamma$ imposes no completeness or origin condition on either endpoint.

proof.text: Use the ambient towerProjection_isIso instance and towerProjection_properties from [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. Their components form a natural isomorphism pi: push f followed by strict reduction is naturally isomorphic to strict reduction followed by towerPush f. Whisker pi by towerPull g. This is exactly the first strict factor towerH in [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map]. No completeness or origin hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: The natural transformation exchangeStrictNatTrans from [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization] has components towerV'. Whisker the preceding projection transformation and this transformation by the functor Rlim of [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality], then compose with the inverse natural directImageRlimIso of [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits], whiskered by the pulled strict reduction tower. The resulting component is definitionally completedExchange. Symmetry of its naturality equation proves the first conjunct for arbitrary H, H' and a.

proof.text: For intrinsically complete H apply [lem-weil-pbc-intrinsic-to-tower-complete]. For each n separately, take the four corner comparison isomorphisms and the fourth evaluation equation from [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization]. This equation says ev_n(towerV') followed by alpha_3 equals alpha_1 followed by restriction of the v' isomorphism of [def-weil-pbc-four-arrows]. Its right side is invertible, so cancellation of alpha_3 makes ev_n(towerV') invertible. Each witness W n is used separately; no compatibility or common bound is introduced.

proof.text: Apply DerivedCategory.isIso_iff from [lem-weil-pbc-unbounded-derived-iso-cohomology] to towerV'. For each integer i and each n, evaluation commutes with homology by mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso. The isomorphism established in the preceding step therefore implies that the nth component of H^i(towerV') is invertible. By [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian] this is a natural transformation of towers; NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app makes H^i(towerV') invertible. The derived criterion proves towerV' invertible.

proof.text: Unfold completedExchange as specified in [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map]. Its first and last factors are functorial images or components of isomorphisms, and its middle factor is Rlim of the strict isomorphism just proved. Functors preserve isomorphisms, so the composite is invertible. The equality with completedBaseChangeMap is definitional: this map is completedExchange with the displayed hypotheses retained as unused arguments.

Stacks chooses each L_n separately with no compatibility between witnesses, so the item's 'independent witnesses' hypothesis is Stacks' hypothesis (2) and the six steps follow Stacks' route. Statement: the factors of gamma_H type-check for every ambient H. On complete H, P_g is Lg^*_comp, and def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map asks only for one witness per n, so no hypothesis is weakened. Step 1: Pi is invertible via the coefficient inverse image, tower-evaluation counit normalization and the perfect projection formula, then levelwise cohomology and the unbounded criterion. Step 2: the conjugation formula agrees with def-cbc-completed-exchange-map, and naturality cancels correctly. Step 3: composing the three naturality squares is genuinely elementary. Step 4: I checked directions (ev_n t = chi^{-1}); ev_n(v_H) = h'_n v_n h_n^{-1} = Ex^{P_n} by the intrinsic finite rectangle. Step 5: thm-weil-pbc-finite-level-proetale applies per n (P_n finite, H_n in D^+ via the witness), so v_H and then gamma are invertible. Step 6: strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization (per-n witnesses, no compatibility) gives v'=H'R(e)H^{-1}, so the three ordered factors equal those of Ex^comp. Edge cases checked: H=0, non-complete H, lower bounds tending to -infinity, g=id. No new nodes, no SGA, proof_deps match the step uses, and no existing node duplicates the item (thm-weil-pbc-complete-proetale needs compatible witnesses; completed-exchange-coherence covers only complete inputs). I accept the 13 generic sk-thm-properbasechange tool_uses. Advisory: the prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction citation in Step 4 is not needed. No fixes.
